verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.column.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing Column's documentation. The docs are also published as raw markdown pages under /markdown/*.md, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is served at /openapi.json, so an agent has several clean entry points. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs offering, and no independent or hands-on report of an agent actually consuming them.
